title: NEPSEE: A Double-Annotated Benchmark for Nepali Sentiment Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.19190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many sentiment datasets use one annotator for each item, so the test labels show the conventions of that person. We build a Nepali benchmark from two annotators who labelled the same sentences blind. They labelled 5,614 sentences from tweets of Nepali public figures on a five-point scale. We keep only the 3,189 sentences where both give the same polarity. On the three-class benchmark, NepBERTa with a fixed tokenizer gets a macro-F1 of 0.877 and IndicBERTv2 0.867. Three commercial large language models (LLMs) get 0.882 to 0.896 zero-shot, and these differences are not significant. On the five-point scale, 766 sentences have two adjacent labels, for example Pos and SPos. We accept both labels and train on both. On this task, Claude Opus 5.5 beats the best encoders by 0.10 to 0.12 macro-F1. A tokenizer audit adds a second result. The default tokenizers of three Nepali BERT models delete the non-spacing Devanagari vowel signs and the virama.

translated_title: NEPSEE：一个双重标注的尼泊尔语情感分析基准数据集
translated_abstract: 许多情感数据集对每个条目只使用一名标注者，因此测试标签反映的是该标注者个人的标注习惯。我们构建了一个尼泊尔语基准数据集，由两名标注者对相同的句子进行盲标。他们对来自尼泊尔公众人物推特的5,614个句子进行了五级量表标注，我们只保留了两位标注者给出相同极性的3,189个句子。在三类分类基准上，使用修正分词器的NepBERTa获得了0.877的宏F1分数，IndicBERTv2为0.867。三个商业大语言模型（LLM）零样本获得0.882到0.896的分数，且这些差异并不显著。在五级量表上，有766个句子被标注为相邻的两个标签，例如“积极”和“较积极”，我们同时接受这两个标签并在两者上进行训练。在这项任务上，Claude Opus 5.5的宏F1分数比最佳编码器高出0.10到0.12。分词器审查提供了第二个结果：三个尼泊尔语BERT模型的默认分词器会删除天城文的非间隔元音符号和止符（virama）。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个由两名标注者独立盲标的双标注尼泊尔语情感分析基准NEPSEE，发现商业大语言模型在细粒度五级情感标注任务上显著优于最佳编码器模型，并揭示了现有尼泊尔语BERT模型分词器会丢失天城文元音符号的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NEPSEE, a double-annotated Nepali sentiment benchmark with blind labels from two annotators, showing that commercial LLMs significantly outperform the best encoders on fine-grained five-point sentiment classification and revealing that default Nepali BERT tokenizers delete Devanagari vowel signs and the virama.
